source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Schedule 1 line 1 column A, PDF p.64

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 60,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 44,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 0 x 20.00 = 0.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 40.00. Line 1c federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 federal taxable income 44,250.00. Schedule 1 line 1 column A: Iowa municipal interest 2,000.00 added. Schedule 1 line 1 column A: other states' municipal interest 3,000.00 added. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = 5,000.00; line 3 = 5,000.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 44,250.00 + (5,000.00) = 49,250.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 49,250.00 = 1,871.50; line 7 = 1,871.50. Line 11 total credits 40.00; line 12 balance = 1,871.50 - 40.00 = 1,831.50. State income tax 1,831.50 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 49,250.00 + federal deduction 15,750.00 = 65,000.00, against 9,000.00: not exempt. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. Municipal interest is not in federal AGI. Line 1 column A adds it 'unless specifically exempt'; the Iowa bonds here are taken as not on the printed list (PDF p.64), and the projection taxes all of it.
accepted_approximations: All municipal interest is taxed; a printed list of Iowa issues (PDF p.64) and bonds of Guam, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands (PDF p.65) is exempt, and other Iowa bonds are taxed like other states' bonds.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
